verdict.rationale: Supabase branching creates separate environments, including per-PR preview environments, for testing database schema changes without touching production. The official MCP server lets an agent drive this end to end: it exposes `create_branch`, `merge_branch`, `reset_branch`, `rebase_branch` and `apply_migration`, and the MCP security docs recommend branching for testing changes safely before merging. A local CLI stack with its own MCP endpoint offers another isolated sandbox. Missing for 10: the MCP branching tool group is labeled experimental, and there is no hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent completing the branch-test-merge workflow.
